## Statement

NB-9, a commuting diagram together with an injective encoding offered as a certificate of semantic transport, is refuted by budgetSim_enc_injective: the square commutes through budget writes alone. It is not used. Its refutation removes the one internal object that could have been mistaken for grounding, so it does not weaken Axis 3.
